title: Creatures Galore
description: Creatures Galore sprung from the fertile imaginations—or the nightmares—at Industrial Light & Magic. Joe Johnston, art director-visual effects, came up with this sketch (front) of a wretched soul. He also drew the baby bug-eyed alien (back) as a possible background character in THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK. Whole galaxies could be populated with creatures that weren't used.
